t: Founded by Clovis I, it was the most durable kingdom to emerge from the Western Roman Empire and the common ancestor of France and Germany.
Clovis’s Catholic baptism allied the Franks with the church; the Carolingians later allied with the papacy, which crowned Charlemagne emperor in 800.
Kings divided the realm among their sons, and the Treaty of Verdun of 843 split it into West, Middle and East Francia.
dyk: The Carolingian reckoning of 12 pennies to the shilling and 240 to the pound survived in Britain’s pounds, shillings and pence until decimalisation in 1971.
ev: Clovis I defeats Syagrius and takes the Roman Domain of Soissons
Clovis defeats the Visigoths at the Battle of Vouillé, winning Aquitaine
The Franks conquer the Kingdom of the Burgundians
Pippin of Herstal wins at Tertry and becomes the real ruler of the Franks
Charles Martel defeats an Umayyad army between Poitiers and Tours
Pippin the Short deposes the last Merovingian king and is anointed
Pope Leo III crowns Charlemagne emperor in Rome
The Treaty of Verdun divides the realm among Charlemagne’s grandsons

f.successor: West Francia, Middle Francia and East Francia
